Let's not use the deprecated `RequestOptions.auto_parse_form_urlencoded`.
Normally, the recommended way to deserialize a body is via [`req.get_media()`](https://falcon.readthedocs.io/en/stable/api/request_and_response_wsgi.html#falcon.Request.get_media).
